correctness.rationale: The exponential-age stationary resolvent has vertical decay exp(-alpha|y|) with alpha=sqrt(r/D_y); integrating across zero gives amplitude r/(2 D_y alpha+D_x k^2), yielding the stated product Laplace law. The local-time normalization gives conditional horizontal variance (D_x/D_y)L_t=2D_x times backbone occupation density integrated in time. The independent reset event contributes no initial–terminal covariance on reset paths; on no-reset paths, conditional martingale means give the ordinary covariance matrix and autonomous vertical motion gives the reverse mixed-square covariance zero. The forward mixed-square covariance is 2D_x exp(-rt) times the time integral of Cov(Y^2,p_s(0|Y)), strictly negative at every s>0 by the independent-copy argument on |Y|. Differentiating the Gaussian–exponential integral with respect to its exponential rate twice gives the stated kernel; differentiating its erfc primitive and checking its value at zero verifies the displayed all-lag formula. The kernel tends to -1 in dimensionless units with O(sqrt(rt)) correction. For an independent check of the long-lag coefficient, the integrated heat-kernel difference from the kernel at y=0 is -|y|/(2D_y); covariance with Y^2 under the Laplace law thus integrates to -2/(D_y alpha^3). These arguments cover every positive lag under the stated strictly positive parameters and exact stationarity.
residual_risks: Finite quadrature is corroborative only. The result requires independent complete Poisson resetting and the specified continuous local-time clock.

value.rationale: A natural hidden coupling of the canonical comb is screened both by the stationary position distribution and by every ordinary covariance. The signed, time-ordered exact statistic distinguishes this dynamics even at arbitrarily small or large positive lags and quantifies the decay; it is also a direct witness against reversibility of the stationary pair. The result gives more than a new quadrature for an arbitrary parameter sample.
residual_risks: No inference about empirical detectability, incomplete resetting or discrete combs is needed for this value judgment.
